# Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort

> Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort is a five-star beachfront hotel at Mina Al Fajer near Dibba, set between the Al Hajar Mountains and the Gulf of Oman on the UAE's east coast. It has 181 guest rooms and suites, two swimming pools, a spa, a fitness centre and a dive centre, alongside several restaurants and bars. The resort adjoins a marina and forms part of a wider mixed-use coastal development.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Dibba, Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2017

## MENASCO Scope

Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort is a beachfront resort at Mina Al Fajer in Dibba, set between the Al Hajar Mountains and the Fujairah coast. Developed by Mina Al Fajer Real Estate as part of a wider mixed-use resort, the hotel offers 181 rooms and suites, a spa and two swimming pools. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the hotel.
